capabilities: Track monthly income, fixed spending, semi-fixed outgoings, and remaining money in a 4-stage pipeline
Record expenses via quick-entry category pills or color wheels per category
Split rent costs 50/50 with a roommate calculator
Carry over recurring income, fixed outgoings, and category budgets into new months
Store monthly state as Markdown tables in finances/YYYY/MM files
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for tracking monthly cashflow and expenses, so users must manage budgets entirely by hand in their notes.
summary: Personal finance tracker that renders a 4-stage monthly expense pipeline (Income, Fixed, Semi-Fixed, What Is Left) backed by Markdown files.
